messages:
maya: Opening a small PR to refresh the Quickstart 'hello-engine' tutorial for SDK7. Main goals: switch examples to ephemeral token flow, fix the broken auth doc link, add a minimal docker smoke test, and clarify port numbers. PTAL if you have a few minutes today.

theo: Thanks! Can you drop the old createSession() snippet and replace with issue_token flow? I ran into that yesterday while testing and it confused new devs.

maya: Yep. Current tutorial points to /docs/auth/session which 404s. I'll update links to /docs/auth/ephemeral-tokens (I created a stub page).

karen: Quick suggestion: show both node and curl flows; many users copy the curl into CI. Example I used: 
```bash
# exchange permanent API key for ephemeral token
EPHEMERAL=$(curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/issue_token \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"expires_in":600}' | jq -r '.token')
# run a smoke call against local container
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL" http://localhost:8080/health
```

arjun: Small nit: in the repo starter the Dockerfile EXPOSEs 3000 but the app starts on 8080, so the run command is inconsistent. We should standardize on 8080 for the container examples.

maya: Good catch. I'll change Dockerfile to EXPOSE 8080 and update the README run command to `docker run -p 8080:8080`.

theo: Also add a one-liner health endpoint example in the app (if absent). Something like: `app.get('/health', (_req, res) => res.json({ok: true}))` so the smoke test is deterministic.

maya: Will add that with a test note: "recommended for containerized quickstarts".

karen: Another UX nit: remove the long Console screenshot on the landing page and instead link to a Console walkthrough until design can produce an updated image. Screenshots get stale fast.

maya: Agreed. I'll replace it with a short callout and a link to the Console page, and file a follow-up ticket to add new images.

docs-bot: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511 (draft). Reviewers: @theo @karen @arjun

arjun: Quick code style: env var should be RW_API_KEY (consistent with other guides). Also prefer double quoted JSON in curl examples for portability.

karen: I'll add a note about not logging ephemeral tokens and a short sentence on expected token lifetime for common scenarios (CI, local dev, ephemeral UIs).

theo: If you want me to run the canary build I can trigger the container build after you push.

maya: Please do when ready. I've pushed the Dockerfile + health endpoint + new snippets.

ci-bot: Canary build queued for PR #511 -> build-2026-03-22-09. Will post status on completion.

theo: LGTM for quick review, left a couple of tiny wording suggestions in the PR.

maya: Thanks all. I'll fold comments, update the PR description with the smoke test and the note about the screenshot swap, then un-draft once the canary passes.

karen: Thanks — great cleanup. This should reduce confusion for first-run users.

ci-bot: Canary build succeeded for PR #511 10 min. Image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/hello-engine:pr-511

maya: Un-drafting the PR now. Marking follow-up: update Console screenshots (design ticket) + add a short section in the quickstart about token rotation patterns.

maya: (post-merge) we're good to ship a small announcement in the docs changelog, will paste the blurb here when merged.
